jobs.title: About us
jobs.description: About Us - Sightec Book a demo pages Product About us Careers Book a demo We enable drones to focus on what matters: the mission Empowering UAVs in Any Environment Founded in 2017, Sightec is a pioneer in software-first Visual Autonomy, built on world-class computer vision and deep operational experience. Our technology transforms raw imagery into reliable navigation and situational awareness- day and night, urban or rural, in GPS-denied and contested environments. We don’t build algorithms; we build mission capabilities. Our solutions are trusted across thousands of operational sorties, ensuring UAVs deliver a seamless, resilient flight experience- even in the most demanding conditions. Building the Foundation for Scalable, Resilient UAV Autonomy We develop foundational visual autonomy technologies that solve the immediate challenges UAV operators face today- while laying the groundwork for fully resilient, software-defined autonomy. By delivering mission-critical assistance capabilities now, Sightec enables a progressive path toward uncompromised autonomous flight across the most complex and contested environments. Our team Engineers, Pilots, and Innovators United by a Mission Sightec’s team blends world-class computer vision engineers with seasoned pilots and operators who have flown and supported real missions in demanding environments. jobs.title: View position : Senior Software Engineer (C++ on real-time Linux, Drone Systems)
jobs.description: Senior Software Engineer (C++ on real-time Linux, Drone Systems) - Sightec Book a demo pages Product About us Careers Book a demo Senior Software Engineer (C++ on real-time Linux, Drone Systems) Role Overview Location: Ramat Gan, Israel Type: Full-time • Hybrid Position: At Sightec, we develop real-time visual autonomy and navigation systems for UAVs operating in GPS-denied environments. Our software runs on edge processors and is deployed to customers worldwide across Defence and HLS sectors. We are looking for a strong C++ developer to join our core engineering team and take a key role in building high-performance, production-grade systems. Key Responsibilities: Develop modern C++ software for Linux-based edge systems Design and implement components for real-time, performance-critical applications Work closely with algorithm developers to integrate computer vision pipelines into production systems Optimize system performance (CPU, memory, latency) under constrained hardware Debug complex issues across multi-threaded and distributed components Support deployment, integration, and field-related issues when needed Requirements: 5+ years of hands-on C++ development experience Strong experience working on Linux-based systems (embedded or edge devices is a plus) Solid understanding of multithreading, synchronization, and memory management Experience with performance-critical or real-time systems Proven ability to debug complex issues in production environments Experience building and shipping production-grade software Strong problem-solving skills and ownership mindset advantages: Experience with NVIDIA Jetson or similar edge platforms Background in UAV, drone systems, or robotics Familiarity with computer vision systems Experience with system-level performance optimization Exposure to CI/CD workflows Experience working in small to mid-sized product companies Familiarity with LLM-assisted development tools (e.g., ClaudeCode, Copilot) Who We Are: We are a small, focused engineering team building systems that operate far beyond the lab. Our work reaches real customers, in real missions, under real constraints. You’ll be working close to the product, close to decisions, and directly impacting how the system performs in the field. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys deep technical work, solving hard problems, and building systems that need to work reliably where it actually matters. jobs.title: View position : Head of Software Engineering
jobs.description: Head of Software Engineering - Sightec Book a demo pages Product About us Careers Book a demo Head of Software Engineering Role Overview Location: Ramat Gan, Israel Type: Full-time • Hybrid (Hands-On C++ / Real-Time Linux, Drone Systems) Position: At Sightec, we develop real-time visual autonomy and navigation systems for UAVs operating in GPS-denied environments. Our software runs on edge processors and is deployed to customers worldwide across Defence and HLS sectors. We are looking for a hands-on engineering leader to take ownership of our software architecture, engineering standards, and product robustness, while remaining deeply involved in development. This role sits at the core of our product. You will work closely with algorithm, integration, and application teams to ensure that advanced computer vision capabilities are translated into stable, production-ready systems that perform reliably in real-world environments. You will help shape software that must operate under tight compute limits, real-time constraints, and field conditions where failure is not theoretical. Key Responsibilities: Lead and mentor a small software team (SW, QA, DevOps, up to 5 people) Stay actively involved in modern C++ development on Linux-based edge systems Own architectural decisions and long-term technical direction Drive system-level performance, stability, and robustness under real-world constraints Strengthen CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows for embedded systems Improve engineering processes and development discipline while maintaining agility Collaborate closely with algorithm engineers to integrate and productize real-time vision capabilities Support field deployment and production at scale Implement LLM-assisted coding tools to enhance and scale team productivity Requirements: Strong hands-on C++ development on Linux-based edge processors such as NVIDIA Jetson Background in real-time or performance-critical systems Deep understanding of multithreading, synchronization, scheduling, and memory behaviour Proven ability to debug complex production issues Track record of delivering production-ready systems Led 4 to 10 engineers in a hands-on capacity Built or improved engineering practices in growing teams Advantages: UAV or drone systems background Integration of LLM-assisted coding tools such as ClaudeCode into structured product lifecycles Computer vision application development System-level performance optimization and debugging Work in small to mid-sized product companies Who We Are: We are a small, focused engineering team building systems that operate far beyond the lab. Our work reaches real customers, in real missions, under real constraints. This role is well suited for someone who enjoys combining deep technical work with leadership and who is motivated by ownership, responsibility, and visible impact ✨ At Sightec, engineers are close to the product, close to decisions, and close to the results of their work. We build camera-based situational awareness and GPS-free navigation solutions for drones and UAVs operating in complex environments. We value technical depth, thoughtful engineering, and people who take pride in delivering reliable systems that work where it truly matters. jobs.title: View position : UAV Field Integration Engineer
jobs.description: UAV Field Integration Engineer - Sightec Book a demo pages Product About us Careers Book a demo UAV Field Integration Engineer Role Overview Location: Ramat Gan, Israel Type: Full-time • Hybrid Position: At Sightec, we develop competitive real-time visual autonomy and navigation systems for UAVs operating in GPS-denied environments. Our technology enables mission-critical aerial operations by turning visual data into real-time navigation and decision-making. Our systems are deployed worldwide across defence and HLS applications, supporting real operational missions and field deployments. We are looking for a UAV Systems Integration Engineer to join our team. This is a highly practical, field-driven role combining UAV integration, flight testing, customer-facing technical work, troubleshooting, and operational deployment. The role sits at the intersection of field activity, customer needs, and product development – working closely with customers and internal software, algorithm, and hardware teams to bring systems from integration to successful deployment. Key Responsibilities: Lead UAV integrations and system validation for customer-specific platforms. Operate UAVs during testing, demos, and field deployments. Integrate and validate electro-optical payloads, cameras, and vision-based systems. Troubleshoot hardware, software, communication interfaces, and system-level failures in lab and field environments. Analyze logs, telemetry, and system behavior to identify root causes and improve performance. Work directly with customers to understand operational needs and support deployments. Translate field issues and customer feedback into actionable engineering requirements. Assemble, configure, and validate system hardware as part of integration workflows. Support new product iterations through field feedback, system improvements, and operational insights. Requirements: Minimum 1 year of professional UAV operation experience (mandatory) — military, commercial, or industrial environments. Hobby-only experience is not sufficient. Hands-on experience integrating and operating Pixhawk-based UAV systems (mandatory). Strong familiarity with flight controllers and mission software (ArduPilot, PX4, Mission Planner, QGroundControl). Proven hands-on experience in UAV system integration and field testing. Experience integrating electro-optical payloads, cameras, or vision-based systems- strong advantage. Strong troubleshooting capabilities across hardware, software, telemetry, and communication interfaces. Ability to analyze logs, telemetry, and system diagnostics. Very good English communication skills Strong team player with a practical, ownership-driven mindset. Willingness to travel internationally for customer deployments, demonstrations, and field testing. More: The position requires real operational UAV experience and proven integration capabilities – not only theoretical knowledge or hobby-level familiarity. You’ll work closely with our software, algorithm, and hardware teams, lead customer integrations, and support live deployments in Israel and abroad. This role is primarily office- and field-based, with limited hybrid flexibility depending on operational and deployment requirements. If you enjoy working in the field, solving technical challenges, and taking systems from lab to mission-ready deployment — this role is for you. Please send CVs to: info@sightec.com Only relevant applications will be considered.
